research_sources.finding: Custom attention backends need matching attention-mask registration; otherwise attention_mask can be None and constraints can be dropped.
Current Llama eager attention receives post-RoPE query/key/value tensors, scaling, and attention_mask before score computation.
A public issue reports changed Llama computation when registering a custom AttentionInterface backend, reinforcing the need for a safer seam.
